description: Default routing by responsibility. Exact owners and test patterns take precedence over primary globs; fallback routing applies only to otherwise unowned source. An Amri-approved exact task override resolves semantic cross-lane work before edits.
rules: Every active task uses unique exact allowed paths; glob routing never grants a task permission.
An exact owner takes precedence, then test patterns, then primary globs, then fallback routing.
Responsibility controls dispatch. Amri records approval.amriApproved and an exact ownerOverrides entry when a task differs from default routing.
Each override must match one assigned path and its sole specialist; tests remain QA responsibility and governance remains Amri responsibility.
Amri captures content hashes before edits, pins the snapshot digest and verifies all subsequent changes, including already dirty files and rename source paths.
Path validation does not establish runtime filesystem isolation or prove which process edited a file.
